先说清需要：活动、餐食与照护是不同项目: First identify the need: activities, meals and care are different programs
中文长者需要的可能是读英文通知、参加活动、送餐、有人探访，或白天有人照护。活动中: A Chinese-speaking elder may need help reading English letters, activities, meal delivery, visits or daytime care. A senior center does not give medical care, and a meal program is not all-day care. Say the county, the language and the kind of help first, then ask what the agency can do.

旧金山：安老自助处的日间照护与资源协调: San Francisco: Self-Help for the Elderly day services and resource coordination
安老自助处（Self-Help for the Elderly）的成人日间照护有: Self-Help for the Elderly's adult day services have staff who speak Mandarin, Cantonese and Toisanese, at the Jackie Chan Center, 408 22nd Avenue, San Francisco, 415-677-7556. Participants need written approval from their primary care doctor and a TB clearance from the past 12 months; Medi-Cal pays for those who qualify, and private-pay rates by level of care are available.

餐食：到中心吃饭、送餐和餐厅计划分别询问: Meals: ask separately about center dining, delivery and restaurant programs
安老自助处的餐食分三种：送餐（Home Delivered Meals）、到中心: Self-Help for the Elderly runs three meal programs: Home Delivered Meals, Congregate Meals at a center and the CHAMPSS restaurant program. If your relative can go out, ask about shared meals; if not, meal delivery. Ask whether the address is covered, how to sign up, whether there is a waitlist, and about diets and payment or donations.

东湾：Family Bridges 中文陪伴与 Oakland 中心: East Bay: Family Bridges Chinese-language companionship and Oakland center
Family Bridges 的探访项目（Visiting Program）服务: Family Bridges' Visiting Program serves Mandarin- and Cantonese-speaking elders: volunteers visit regularly, call to check in and help with light shopping. It is for people 60 and up in Alameda, Albany, Berkeley, Emeryville, Oakland or Piedmont who are homebound or isolated. The program is free; office hours are Monday–Friday 9 a.m.–3 p.m., 510-839-2022. Ask the program to review the address and needs and about any waitlist; volunteer companionship is not medical or all-day home care.

家属或长者第一次联系时准备什么: What to prepare for the first call
准备长者住的市和县、想用普通话、粤语还是其他语言，以及由本人还是获授权的家属联系: Have ready the city and county, whether Mandarin, Cantonese or another language, and whether the elder or an authorized relative will be the contact.
用日常事实说明需要：能不能出门吃饭、想不想有人陪、白天需要哪些帮助；照护评估交给: Describe needs with everyday facts: can they go out to eat, do they want company, what help do they need during the day; leave care assessments to the program's professionals.
逐项问服务区域、年龄等条件、医生转介、费用或捐款、候补、接送和语言，记下下一步和: Ask about service area, age and other conditions, doctor referral, fees or donations, waitlist, rides and language one by one, and note the next step and what to submit.
给长者服务机构的询问说明: A first-call script for a senior-service provider
我为自己／获授权协助家属找服务，住在___市___县，希望用普通话／粤语／___: I am finding services for myself / assisting an authorized family member in ___ city, ___ county, and prefer Mandarin/Cantonese/___. We need meals/activities/visits/day care/caregiver support because ___. Does your program serve this address? How do we check eligibility, assessment, costs and waiting lists? What language help, transport or referrals can be arranged, and whom should we contact next?
先核实机构，再提交长者资料: Verify the provider before sharing an older adult’s documents
公开求助只写大致需要，不写完整生日、保险号码、医疗记录、住址或收入证明。家属代办: In public posts describe the need only: no full birth date, insurance numbers, medical records, address or income papers. Before acting for a relative, get their consent and ask the agency what authorization it needs; send documents through the agency's secure channel.
